message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing three benchmark performance scores across training steps.","description":"A line chart with Training Steps on the horizontal axis, marked from 0 to 270 in increments of 30, and Performance Score on the vertical axis, with labeled ticks from 0.35 to 0.65 in increments of 0.05. Three connected series are identified by a legend at lower right: CruxEval-I uses blue circles, CruxEval-O uses red squares, and LiveCodeBench-Execution uses green triangles. There are no printed values at the data points; the chart_values are estimated read-offs. CruxEval-O is generally highest, rising from about 0.40 to a peak near 0.63 before ending near 0.61. CruxEval-I rises overall from about 0.41 to around 0.60, with several fluctuations and a sharp dip near step 160. LiveCodeBench-Execution starts lowest at about 0.35, climbs unevenly, and reaches roughly 0.63 at step 270; it has noticeable dips near steps 160 and 260. The three series converge near the upper end of the chart, with the green series highest at the final
